arStrings.szText: {c_important}Arc Lash{/c} now casts from both sides in a larger arc, hitting enemies caught in the middle twice.

{c_important}Arc Lash{/c} launches a swift projectile that unleashes arcing lightning at the first enemy hit, dealing up to {c_number}[{SF_24} * 100}|%x|]{/c} increased damage based on how far the projectile travels.

Hitting an enemy with {c_important}Arc Lash's{/c} projectile increases your Movement Speed by {c_number}[SF_17*100|+%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}[SF_17*100*SF_14|+%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Arc Lash{/c} becomes a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill, deals Cold damage, and {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_21|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Arc Lash{/c} has a larger range and deals up to {c_number}[{SF_22} * 100}|%x|]{/c} increased damage based on how {c_important}{u}Chilled{/u}{/c} the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Arc Lash{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_9*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.
{c_important}Arc Lash{/c} generates {c_number}[{SF_11}]{/c} Mana when it hits the first enemy.
Every {c_number}[SF_12]{/c} seconds your next {c_important}Arc Lash{/c} will Stun all enemies hit for {c_number}[SF_13]{/c} seconds.
